questions.q: What command opens Active Directory Users and Computers?
options: gpmc.msc
services.msc
compmgmt.msc
dsa.msc
questions.explain: dsa.msc opens Active Directory Users and Computers, which shows the domain's OU structure and lets you create and manage users, groups, and computers.

questions.q: What is the key difference between a security group and a distribution group?
options: A distribution group can be granted permissions but a security group cannot
There is no real difference between them
A security group can be granted permissions to resources; a distribution group cannot and exists only for email
A security group can only exist inside the Finance OU
questions.explain: A security group is a security principal that can be placed in an NTFS permission list or GPO filter. A distribution group has no security identifier and cannot be granted permissions.

questions.q: What happens if you try to grant file share permissions to a distribution group?
options: The distribution group is automatically converted to a security group
It fails silently — the group shows up in the permission list but members don't actually get access
Active Directory blocks you from adding it to the list at all
It works exactly like a security group
questions.explain: A distribution group has no security identifier for NTFS or sharing permissions to act on, so granting it access silently does nothing for its members.

questions.q: In the A-G-DL-P nesting pattern, what does a Global group typically represent?
options: A single user account
The permission itself, applied directly to a resource
A forest-wide trust relationship
A real-world collection of people, nested inside a Domain Local group that holds the actual permission
questions.explain: Global groups represent people (like "Finance-Employees") and are nested inside a Domain Local group, which is the group actually granted the permission on a resource.

questions.q: What does the following PowerShell do? Add-ADGroupMember -Identity "Finance-Employees" -Members "jlee"
options: Adds the user jlee to the Finance-Employees group
Removes jlee from the Finance-Employees group
Grants jlee permission to the Finance file share directly
Creates a new user named jlee
questions.explain: Add-ADGroupMember adds the specified member (jlee) to the specified group (Finance-Employees).
